color.rule: Color supports hierarchy and state; it must never imply unverified clinical meaning

typography.display: Humanist editorial serif or locally available serif fallback
typography.body: Accessible humanist sans or system sans fallback
typography.interface: Body family with medium and semibold weights
typography.principle: Professional, calm, legible, and less fashion-editorial than the current oversized grotesk treatment

spacing.principle: Use whitespace to separate evidence groups, not to create spectacle

layout.composition: Asymmetric editorial layouts with consistent alignment rails
layout.principle: One shared shell and one shared section grammar across every route

shape.images: Controlled rectangular crops with thin keylines
shape.principle: Precise and document-like, avoiding soft SaaS containers

elevation.principle: Use borders and tonal planes before shadows

motion.principle: Motion confirms hierarchy and state; no constant animation, scroll hijacking, or decorative loops

design_style.visual_thesis: A professional clinical dossier translated into a warm editorial website: credible, precise, human, and quietly distinctive.
design_style.interaction_thesis: Interactions should feel immediate and composed. Navigation, disclosure, and feedback receive motion; reading content remains stable.
design_style.composition: Structured asymmetry, document margins, annotated evidence rows, restrained fields of clinical green
anti_generic_rules: No glass panels except functional overlays

visual_effects.threejs_decision: Rejected: no meaningful information benefit, added bundle cost, maintenance burden, and accessibility risk
visual_effects.reduced_motion: All content visible immediately; state changes remain clear without spatial movement
